# Cloneable

A type whose values can be duplicated by calling [`Clone`](/docs/api/core/cloneable#clone): the bound generic code writes before it duplicates an
owning value of its type parameter.

```rux
pub interface Cloneable {
    func Clone(&self) -> Self;
}
```

A clone is independent of its source: each owns what it holds and releases it on its own, and changing one never
changes the other. A handle that shares one value, such as `Rc`, clones by adding another owner of that value.

## Requirements

<h3 id="clone"><code>Clone</code></h3>

```rux
func Clone(&self) -> Self
```

An independent duplicate of this value.
Borrows the source and leaves it unchanged. An implementation that allocates terminates the program when its
allocation fails, because the duplicate it promises cannot be made.

**Returns**: a value equal to this one that owns its own resources
